11. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and order of conviction and sentence the condemned-prisoner as appellant preferred the Jail Appeal No. 900 of 2008. The Death Reference and Jail appeal have been heard together and are being disposed of by this judgment. 

 18. He was cross-examined by the defence in where he stated that the school of his son used to sit at morning 10.00 A. M. and break up at 02.00 P. M. He denied the suggestion that the School sat for 10.00 A. M. to 430 P. M. He also stated that the accused was known to him earlier who used to work as a carpenter. Sometime he used to drive rickshaw and that the accused had no mobile. He denied the suggestion that the accused did not go with his son for loading ring tune for his mobile. He stated that the distance of the residence of the accused Masum and his residence is about 50 yard. He also stated that his residence of the southern side of the rail line and the residence of the accused is north side of the rail line. He denied the suggestion that accused was not going at night 03.00 A. M. He also denied the suggestion that the accused did not confess about the killing of his son and conceal the dead body in the pucca drain and even the accused did not pointing out the place of occurrence and the dead body was not recovered at his pointing out. He denied the suggestion that he deposed falsely due to previous enmity with accused-appellant Masum and he also denied the suggestion that the accused did not kill the victim. 

 25, P.W.5, Md. Rakibul Islam stated in his deposition that he was a student of clam Seven of Police line High School. They have a grocery 'shop at Bipassinore of Harogram and occurrence took place on 20.08.2006 at noon while he was in their shop the accused Masum sat on the bench in front of their shop. The deceased Hemel also came near to the accused Masum while he was returning from the school. It was further stated that Hemel asked to Masum with a request to take him for loading a ring tune then Masum asked Hemal to bring the mobile from their house. In pursuance of said statement of the accused the victim Hemal went to the house and after sometimes he came back with his mobile in front of their shop while Masum was also sat in front of their shop. At that time the mother of Nemol also came behind the victim and it was also stated that Hemal informed his mother that he was going with Masum for loading ring tune, thereafter Hemel and Masum together went from there. He identified the accused Mat= on the dock. 

 26. In his cross-examination he stated that he was the student of Class- VII. And in 2006 he was a student of Class VI. He is a student of police line School. He denied the suggestion that on the date of occurrence he was not present in the shop and he also denied the suggestion that Masum was not sat in front the shop at that time. He also denied the suggestion that he deposed falsely. 

 38. P.W.I 6, Professor Dr. Md. AShraful Alam, stated in his deposition that on 21.08.2006 while he was performing as a Professor and Departmental of Head of Forensic Division of Rajshahi Medical College he conducted the post mortem of the dead body of Hemal and found the following injury which are as follows; "1.0n continuous circular ligature mark found at the lower aspect of the neck the breadth of the ligature is about 1/2", 2. Abrasions found ass both' check and nose about I" in length each. On detailed dissection extravasations of blood ,found corresponding to the wounds. Trachea and larynxibund, fractured. He also proved the post mortem report and his signature which were marked as Exhibit 10 and 10/1. 

 50. P.W.5 is also stated that he was a boy of '13 years and he categorically stated that they have a grocery shop at local bypass more and on 20.08.2006 while he was in his shop at the noon shop at that time accused appellant came there and sat in front of their shop. He also stated that deceased Hemal while he was returning from the school to their house, he also came near to accused Masum in front of his shop and at that time victim Hemal said to Masum about taking a ring tone of his mobile then Masum said to Hemal to bring the mobile from their house who after hearing that advise of the accused went to the house and after sometimes Hemal came back from their house with his mobile in front of his shop to accused. Then Henial and Masum went together for taking Ting tone towards the court Station. 

 57. In the present case the accused appellant along with the victim were meet in front of the grocery shop of P.W. 5 at Horogmm bypass moor. They went together for loading the ringtone in the mobile of the victim towards the court station. In support of the prosecution P.W.5 being the said shop keeper and an independent eye-witness satisfactorily proved that the victim Hemal accompanied with the accused appellant from their residence through his grocery shop of Horograme bypass moor. The victim has seen by the company of the accused appellant for the last time before his disappearance by the P.W.5. Under the above fact and circumstances thereafter at 3.00 A.M. on the following night dated 21.08.2006 the accused appellant was found alone on the rail line beside the house of the informant in where he confessed in presence of the witness about the killing of the victim including the manner and place of occurrence and recovery of the dead body was made at the pointing out of the accused appellant. The dead body was recovered and that confession of the condemned prisoner was corroborated with the inquest report as well as with the post mortem report which were marked as Exhibits- 9 and 5 respectively. 

 70. On careful consideration of the evidence and materials on record to the case in hand including in the light of the decisions as cited above i.e. 42 DLR 177, 35 DLR 170 and 32 DLR 227 which are also support to the present case. Therefore we hold that the prosecution had satisfactorily proved the inculpatory extra-Judicial confession and attending circumstances that condemned prisoner Md. Masum Islam Sheikh did commit the murder of the victim intentionally and concealed the dead body in the pucca drain under the close gate of the College. That is to say the prosecution had proved the charge regarding the time, place and manner of occurrence against the condemned prisoner beyond reasonable doubt. The trial Court has rightly found guilty and as such properly convicted the condemned prisoner by the trial Court under Section 302/201 of the Penal Code.
